migration.name: 20260728180000_add_catalog_builder_packaging
migration.backfill: None. New packaging tables begin empty and all added compatibility fields are nullable; no bundle, price list, promotion, eligibility, configuration, or SKU is inferred.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Bundle composition follows the parent CatalogItem lifecycle and is retained as effective catalog structure until deliberately changed.

fields.reason: Represents an explicit component relationship instead of inferring bundles from names or archetypes.
fields.fieldPolicy: Parent and component must belong to the same organization; self-reference is rejected.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Price lists and entries are effective-dated commercial definitions retained for traceability; no historical order price is rewritten.

fields.reason: Provides deliberate organization-scoped pricing packages for canonical catalog items and optional SKUs.
fields.fieldPolicy: Entries require canonical catalog references; absent price evidence remains absent.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Promotions are effective-dated and retained with their explicit item scope; expiration changes availability rather than deleting provenance.

fields.reason: Keeps promotions explicit and traceable instead of changing canonical item identity.
fields.fieldPolicy: Promotion items remain within the promotion organization and use declared adjustment terms.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Channel eligibility follows the catalog item and records deliberate publication scope; removing a channel does not delete the catalog item.

fields.reason: Projects canonical items through existing channels without making the channel a product authority.
fields.fieldPolicy: Eligibility is explicit per channel; no storefront exposure is inferred.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: Nullable packaging and provenance fields follow their owning records and preserve legacy rows unchanged.

fields.reason: Adds fulfillment routing, reusable-configuration promotion provenance, and SKU traceability through existing authorities.
